title: PixelKin - The Old Seams (bare gbc)
_note: The Old Seams (09-the-wild-ways §2D): the sealed deep galleries under Cinderhead - plank bridges over shafts, ore-cart rails, water dripping, and far below the first fallen star (Emberroot) breathing as the coal. Bare 4-voice gbc is right here (deep cave, score bible §3.3). 80 BPM (the gbc floor; it reads as half-time), 4/4, C# minor with a Phrygian D natural for the deep. Stone signature: low pulse25 drone-lead, dry pick-tap toms, sparse. pulse12 = DRIPS (single high notes, each echoed fainter), turning to a slow rail-tick in the B section (the rail yard). tri_bass = THE BREATH: long bottom-register tones that swell and ebb by velocity, inhale/exhale every two bars, with silences between. Vesper motif: caves = fragmented - only the rising leap G#3->C#4->D#4 survives; the settle never arrives (it sinks to the Phrygian D instead). Silence is an instrument. 24 bars = 72 s. Original (VISION.md).
